name: Full Inventory
author: Tutez
description: See your whole inventory past its storage limit, stack identical chests, and open chests or unequip weapons when full.
longDescription:
Your inventory can hold more weapons and chests than its storage limit, but the game only shows as many pages as that limit fills: the rest is out of reach. A full storage also blocks some actions. With this mod:
- The Weapons tab has as many pages as it needs to show everything.
- Identical chests take a single slot, with their count, beyond the game's own stacks of 99.
- Chests open even when your storage is full, as before 1.0, and those won at the end of a dungeon can be kept.
- An equipped weapon's card has its Unequip button even when your storage is full.
- Next to Add Storage, what the storage holds against its limit, as the game counts it: unequipped weapons and stacks of chests.

The servers still refuse two things past the limit: buying weapons in the shop, and ascending a hero, even with no weapon to unequip.
